A little beyond the code.

PERSONAL STORY

Self-taught.Always learning.

  • HIP HOP
  • GAMES & PERSONAL PROJECTS

I started my journey in IT as a self-taught learner — learning through hands-on practice, which helped me pick up new things quickly from the start. My day-to-day work in IT Support & QA sharpens my problem-solving instincts: every user issue is a puzzle to solve, and understanding where an application 'hurts' makes me want to build it properly even more. That's the reason behind my big goal: to become a Fullstack Developer and eventually build my own products.

In my spare time, I work on personal projects I enjoy. Beyond coding, I also enjoy playing games and hip hop music. For me, the best projects come from things I genuinely love, and there's no more enjoyable way to learn than that.
